clip-path: circle() clips a solid square to a centered circular disc. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.
clip-path: ellipse() clips a solid rectangle to a centered ellipse with distinct x/y radii. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.

clip-path: inset() with a round radius clips a solid box to a rounded-corner rectangle. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.
clip-path: polygon() clips a solid square into a diamond via four percentage vertices. CSS clip-path on boxes is unsupported.

mask-image: radial-gradient() leaves a solid disc fading to transparent at the edges. CSS mask is unsupported.

align-items:center centers differently-tall boxes on the cross axis of a fixed-height row container.
align-items:stretch expands auto-height boxes to fill the cross-axis height of the container.
align-self overrides container align-items per item: one box flex-end, one centered, one flex-start.
display:flex lays three fixed-size boxes in a row along the main axis with default packing.
flex-basis sets explicit main-size for non-growing non-shrinking boxes (60/160/100px).
flex-direction:column stacks items top-to-bottom along the vertical main axis.
flex-grow distributes free space in a 1:2:1 ratio over zero-basis boxes.
flex-shrink removes overflow in a 1:2 ratio when two oversized boxes exceed the container width.
flex-wrap:wrap breaks four boxes onto two lines when they overflow the container width.
gap:24px inserts a fixed 24px gap between adjacent flex items on the main axis.
justify-content:center groups items centered on the main axis with equal leftover space on both sides.
justify-content:space-around distributes items with equal space around each, so edge gaps are half the inner gaps.
justify-content:space-between pins first and last boxes to the edges with equal gaps between.
min-width floors how far a flex item may shrink, forcing the other item to absorb the rest of the overflow.
A row flex container holds two growing column flex containers, each space-between stacking two boxes.
order reorders source boxes (3,1,2) into visual order blue,green,red on the main axis.
An @font-face rule registering a second custom family ('ParityCustom') from the bundled ParitySerif TTF via src: url(), exercising the @font-face declaration and family-matching mechanism.
Text with font-feature-settings: "liga" 0 to disable standard ligatures (aspirational; no CSS font-feature control, default shaping always applied).
font-size: 5ch sized relative to the advance of the '0' glyph in a monospace face (aspirational; the ch unit is not confirmed in length parsing).
font-size: 2em resolved against the parent region's 16px font-size for a 32px effective size.
font-size: 4ex sized relative to the font's x-height (aspirational; the ex unit is not confirmed in length parsing).
font-size: 150% resolved against the parent region's 20px font-size for a 30px effective size.
font-size: 2rem resolved against the root 16px font-size (32px), independent of the local 10px font-size.
Text with font-stretch: condensed selecting a narrower face/width (aspirational; font-stretch is not parsed or matched).
Mixed-case text rendered with font-variant: small-caps so lowercase letters become small uppercase forms (aspirational; no font-variant support).
Lowercase words rendered with text-transform: capitalize so the first letter of each word is uppercased.
Uppercase source text rendered with text-transform: lowercase so every glyph is lowercased before shaping.
Lowercase source text rendered with text-transform: uppercase so every glyph is uppercased before shaping.

::first-letter floats and enlarges the initial letter of a paragraph into a drop cap with text wrapping beside it.
::first-line restyles only the first wrapped line of a paragraph to red bold while later lines stay normal.
::after appends a literal string after the element text inside a filled, bordered box.
content: "" with display:inline-block renders an empty ::before as a filled, bordered marker box before the text.
::before inserts a literal red string in front of the element text inside a filled, bordered box.
content: open-quote / close-quote on ::before and ::after wraps text in quotation marks from the quotes property.

First cell spans two rows (grid-row: span 2) within a 2x2 grid.
Named column lines [start] [mid] [end] referenced by grid-column to place overlapping cells.
Three columns sized 100px auto 100px so the auto track absorbs the leftover width.
Three columns sized 1fr 2fr 1fr so the middle track is twice the width of the side tracks.
Two flexible columns using minmax(80px,1fr) and minmax(120px,1fr) distributing remaining space.
Three columns sized 25% 50% 25% of a fixed-width grid container.
Four equal 80px columns produced by repeat(4, 80px).

A box with width:200px and aspect-ratio:2/1, expected to derive a 100px height.

overflow:clip clips the oversized child to the clip box with no scroll container (modern clip keyword).
overflow:hidden combined with border-radius clips the overflowing child to the rounded corners of the clip box.
overflow:hidden clips an oversized in-flow child to the clip box; the child is cut off at the right and bottom edges.
A flex item with overflow:hidden clips its oversized inner block to the flex item box while the sibling item is unaffected.
A grid cell with overflow:hidden clips its oversized inner block to the cell box while the sibling cell is unaffected.
Nested overflow:hidden boxes; the visible region is the intersection of the outer and inner clip rectangles, with the grandchild clipped by both.
overflow:hidden on a short fixed-height box clips overflowing text lines below the box edge (bundled ParitySans).
overflow:scroll produces no scrollbars in print; the oversized child is clipped to the box edges with no interactive scroll affordance.
overflow:visible (explicit) does not clip; the oversized child paints beyond the parent box on the right and bottom.
overflow-x:hidden clips horizontally while overflow-y:visible lets the child overflow downward only.
Modern break-before:page on the first block is a no-op (no preceding content), so a single page renders. Tracks the modern break-* family, unparsed by the engine.
Modern break-inside:avoid keeps a card intact on a single page. Content already fits, so the rendered result equals an unbroken nested box; tracks the modern break-inside gap.

The page property names an @page rule (page: cover). Named pages are unsupported and fixtures may not declare @page, so output must match a plain block on the default page. Tracks the named-pages gap.
orphans:3/widows:3 on a paragraph whose lines all fit on one page have no visible effect; deterministic text in a bordered frame tracks the orphans/widows gap.
page-break-after:always on the last in-flow block (nothing follows it) must not spill content onto a second page; the layout stays a single Letter page with both blocks stacked.
page-break-before:avoid on content that already fits on one page is a no-op; both blocks remain stacked. Tracks the legacy avoid-value gap.
page-break-inside:avoid on a table that already fits keeps the whole table on one page. Tracks the legacy page-break-inside gap with a geometry-deterministic table.
content: counter(page) resolves the current page number on the single Letter page. CSS page counters in margin boxes are unsupported; tracks the gap.
Page margin exercised through an explicit 40px body margin (fixtures may not use @page); a filled, bordered content box is inset uniformly inside the single Letter page.
clear:both pushes the cleared block below preceding floats instead of wrapping beside them.
Absolute box resolves against the nearest positioned ancestor, skipping intermediate static parents.
A transform on a non-positioned ancestor makes it the containing block for an absolute descendant.
float:left removes the box from flow and shifts it left; the following block wraps around its right side.
position:relative with negative top/left pulls the box up and left, overlapping prior flow.
All four insets set with auto size make an absolute box stretch to fill the containing block inset by 30px.
overflow:hidden on a positioned ancestor clips an absolutely positioned descendant past the clip edges.
overflow:hidden clips an oversized in-flow child to the parent box.
overflow:visible (default) does not clip; the child overflows the parent box.
position:fixed box placed by top/left relative to the page box on a single non-scrolling page.
position:absolute box anchored to bottom/right edges of its containing block.
position:absolute box placed by top/left within a relative containing block.
position:relative shifts the box by top/left from its in-flow position; flow space is preserved.
position:static box ignores top/left offsets and stays in normal flow.
Without z-index, positioned siblings stack in source order; the later box paints over the earlier.
Higher z-index paints on top of a later-in-source sibling with lower z-index.
Substrate probe: a pure background-color rectangle. Trust anchor for background-color paint.
Substrate probe: two stacked solid blocks. Trust anchor for block box generation + normal vertical flow.
Substrate probe: one box with a thick solid border and transparent fill. Trust anchor for border paint.
Substrate probe: one solid-filled box of known px size. Trust anchor for box-sizing + fill paint + page geometry.
Substrate probe: a short line of ParitySans text at a known size on a baseline rule. Trust anchor for font metrics + baseline placement.
Substrate probe: a small data:-URI PNG placed at a known size. Trust anchor for raster image decode + placement.
@media print { } applies in the print rendering context, turning the box green; ignoring print media queries leaves it gray.
@supports (display:block) { } gates a green override that a correct engine applies; engines without @supports parsing drop it and leave the box gray. Aspirational known-gap.
[data-pick="yes"] colors only the box whose attribute equals the value; boxes with a different value or no attribute stay gray.
A class rule with !important overrides an id selector that would otherwise win on specificity; only the !important box turns green.
Two equal-specificity rules target the same element; the later declaration wins, so the box renders green not gray.
The adjacent-sibling combinator (+) matches only the box immediately following .marker; the marker and the third box stay gray.
The child combinator (>) matches only immediate children of #parent; a nested .box stays gray while direct-child boxes turn green.
The descendant combinator (space) matches every .box inside #parent at any depth; a .box outside #parent stays gray.
The general-sibling combinator (~) matches every later .box sibling of .marker, not just the next one; the marker stays gray.
:first-child paints the first box green and :last-child paints the last box blue; the middle box stays gray.
:not(.skip) colors every .box except the one carrying .skip; the skipped box stays gray.
:nth-child(odd) colors the 1st, 3rd and 5th of five boxes green; even-position boxes stay gray.
:root paints the page background green behind a centered white bordered panel; if :root is unmatched the page stays white.
A class selector (0,1,0) overrides a type selector (0,0,1) regardless of source order; only the .pick box turns green.
An id selector (1,0,0) overrides a more numerous class selector (0,2,0) on the same element; only the box carrying the id turns green.
border-collapse:collapse merges adjacent 4px cell borders into shared single edges.
border-collapse:separate with zero spacing keeps each cell's 4px border doubled at shared edges.
border-collapse:separate with 12px border-spacing exposes the table background between cells.
A top-side caption renders as a full-width banner above the table body.
20px cell padding insets a filled inner box from the cell border on all sides.
A header cell with colspan=2 spans two fixed columns above a normal three-cell row.
Fixed-layout columns at 25%/50%/25% of a 400px table resolve to proportional widths.
empty-cells:hide suppresses borders and backgrounds of cells with no content in a separated table.
A first-column cell with rowspan=2 spans both rows while later columns stay single-row.
2x3 collapsed-border table of fixed 120x60px cells forming a basic grid.
table-layout:auto sizes columns to the widest cell intrinsic width (50/100/160px cells).
table-layout:fixed honors explicit colgroup col widths (60/120/180px) for column sizing.
thead, tbody and tfoot row groups render in document order with distinct section backgrounds.
Short monospace text aligned left, center and right within three equal cells.
th header cells in the first row vs td data cells, with distinct fills and text.
A 24px marker box aligns to top, middle and bottom within tall 120px cells.
direction:rtl right-aligns the inline content and reverses run order; aspirational, no RTL/bidi support in ironpress.
hyphens:auto inserts soft hyphens at language-aware break points; aspirational, no CSS hyphens support in ironpress.
overflow-wrap:break-word breaks an over-long word so it does not overflow the narrow fixed-width box.
tab-size:8 with white-space:pre aligns tab stops at eight character widths; aspirational, no tab-size support in ironpress.
text-indent:40px indents only the first line of a wrapped paragraph while later lines start at the content edge.
text-overflow:clip on an overflow:hidden nowrap fixed-width box hard-clips overflowing text with no ellipsis.
text-overflow:ellipsis on an overflow:hidden nowrap fixed-width box renders a trailing ellipsis where text is clipped.
unicode-bidi:bidi-override with direction:rtl forces visual right-to-left ordering of glyphs; aspirational, no bidi support in ironpress.
white-space:normal collapses runs of spaces and newlines into single soft-wrappable spaces.
white-space:nowrap forces a single line that is clipped by overflow:hidden in a narrow box.
white-space:pre preserves runs of spaces and explicit newlines in monospace text with no wrapping.
white-space:pre-line collapses spaces but preserves explicit newlines, wrapping at the box edge.
white-space:pre-wrap preserves spaces while still soft-wrapping at the box edge.
word-break:break-all breaks the line at any glyph boundary; aspirational, not implemented in ironpress.
writing-mode:vertical-rl lays out glyphs top-to-bottom in a right-to-left column; aspirational, no writing-mode support in ironpress.
Chained transform functions translate(...) rotate(...) compose left-to-right in the box coordinate space. Aspirational: parse_transform returns a single Transform, so chaining is unsupported.
transform: matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f) applies a 2D affine matrix combining scale, shear, and translate in one function. Aspirational: matrix() is not parsed by ironpress.
transform: rotate() turns the box clockwise about its center (default transform-origin) without disturbing layout flow.
transform: scale() enlarges the box uniformly about its center (default transform-origin) without changing layout flow.
transform: scaleX() stretches the box horizontally about its center.
transform: scaleY() stretches the box vertically about its center.
transform: skew() shears the box along X and Y about its center, turning the rectangle into a parallelogram. Aspirational: skew is absent from the ironpress Transform enum and parser.
transform: translate(x, y) shifts a positioned box right and down from its in-flow slot without affecting surrounding layout.
transform: translateX() shifts the box horizontally only, leaving its vertical position unchanged.
transform: translateY() shifts the box vertically only, leaving its horizontal position unchanged.

transform-origin: top left moves the rotation pivot from the box center to its top-left corner, changing where a rotate() lands. Aspirational: ironpress has no transform-origin parse and always pivots about the default origin.
Generic monospace family fallback at 28px with fixed-advance glyphs.
Generic sans-serif family fallback at 28px.
Generic serif family fallback at 28px.
font-size 2em resolved against the parent's 16px font-size.
